description: This Java class 'EnvironmentConfig' provides utilities for managing and validating test environment profiles within a testing framework. It includes methods for environment validation, overlay filename retrieval, environment listing, configuration summary building, and logging configuration details. The class interacts with a 'ConfigManager' to obtain runtime configuration data and masks sensitive information.

classes.name: EnvironmentConfig
classes.description: A utility class for validating environment profiles and generating configuration summaries for test environments.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided environment name is recognized as valid.

methods.name: getOverlayFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the overlay properties for a given environment.

methods.name: getValidEnvironments
methods.description: Provides an unmodifiable set of all recognized environment names.

methods.name: buildConfigSummary
methods.description: Constructs an unmodifiable map summarizing current runtime configuration settings, masking sensitive values.

methods.name: logConfigSummary
methods.description: Logs the current configuration summary at INFO level.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Masks sensitive string values, revealing only the first and last characters.

methods.name: padRight
methods.description: Padding helper method for aligning log output.
